test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: **What was the decision taken by the gentlemen?**

options.text: To give the boys a happy home
To slowly starve the boys to death
To improve things so the children remained ever grateful
To give food, education and care to the boys

solution:
The correct answer is: **To slowly starve the boys to death**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first sentence of the last paragraph in the given passage states, *"**So, they established the rule, that all poor people should be starved by a gradual process__ in the house."*
 
• From here we can conclude that the decision taken by the gentlemen was to slowly starve the boys to death.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**
